description: Sum the XOR of each subset, including the empty subset whose XOR is zero. Equal-valued subsets formed from different indices count separately.
intuition: At each index, recurse once without the value and once with it XORed into the running total. Sum the leaf totals.
approach: At each index, recurse once without the value and once with it XORed into the running total. Sum the leaf totals.

phases.label: Combine one XOR/sum result per call

timeComplexityBreakdown.note: The recursion tree has 2^n leaves and fewer than 2^(n + 1) total calls. It carries a running XOR and never copies a subset.
